name: Cached Line Layout Key Hash

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown: The ordinary wrapped-layout cache can compute one deterministic full-field hash per borrowed request, store that hash in owned keys, and make all current lookup, previous removal, and current insertion map operations hash only the cached scalar. This should reduce full text/run hashing from 921 calls per warmed frame to approximately 320 while preserving collision-safe full equality and exact two-generation cache behavior.
measurementPlanMarkdown: Add a cached deterministic Fx hash to ordinary `CacheKey` and its borrowed lookup representation. Compute it once from all identity fields when each lookup key is formed, make map hashing consume only that scalar, and retain full-field equality so collisions cannot alias layouts. Keep existing map types and rollover/eviction flow. Update diagnostics to count full-field hash computations rather than cheap scalar map hashes. Validate focused equality/collision/cache behavior, the full gpux and serialized WGPU suites, production and diagnostic checks, formatting, Clippy, and repeated headed WebGPU Test Suite runs at DPR 1 and DPR 2. Require the established 320-request cache partition and all rendering/layout invariants to remain exact.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown: Full-field cache-key hash computations should fall from 921 to 320 per warmed frame (about 65.3%), with text-byte and run-item hashing falling proportionally, while 19 current hits, 301 previous hits, zero misses, 322 equality probes, final geometry, and renderer counters remain exact. End-to-end cadence must not materially regress at either DPR.

reportMarkdown:
## Cached Line Layout Key Hash Finished

**Index:** 60
**Checkpoint:** `daee113db`
**Result:** `e0fd4b2b1e1e10c41f7792c5eb2fa3fcc853e21c`
**Attempt Count:** 1

### Report

**Passed Status:** true. Ordinary line-layout cache keys now compute one deterministic full-field Fx hash per borrowed request and retain it in owned keys. Existing map operations hash only the cached scalar, while equality compares the hash and every identity field. No crate, map type, raw-entry API, cache tier, lifetime, or public API was added.

Across three final headed processes per DPR, the warmed frame consistently reduced full-field hashes from 921 to 320 (-65.26%), text bytes hashed from 17,178 to 6,006 (-65.04%), and run items from 921 to 320 (-65.26%). The changed bucket distribution caused two additional collision-safe equality probes (322 to 324), a 0.62% increase, while 19 current hits, 301 previous hits, zero misses, and every rendering/layout invariant remained exact. A forced-collision unit oracle proves distinct full keys remain distinct during borrowed map lookup even when their cached hashes are identical.

Against experiment 59's instrumented checkpoint, the three-process candidate median acknowledged throughput improved 2.56% at DPR 1 and 0.41% at DPR 2. Paced p95 moved -0.61% and -0.81%, respectively, which is not material relative to run variance. The bounded storage trade-off is one `u64` per ordinary owned key; the diagnostic multithreaded WASM atomic prefix increased by 878 bytes.

All 417 gpux unit tests and integration suites, all 52 serialized WGPU tests, production and diagnostic checks, focused formatting, Clippy with warnings denied, the collision oracle, and all six final headed WebGPU cases passed. The first headed measurement reached the correct 320 count but failed the retained experiment-59 `> requests` assertion; the oracle alone was updated to require the experiment-60 one-hash-per-request contract before the three final runs.

### Scope Lock

Only ordinary `CacheKey` construction, hashing/equality, its focused tests, the existing full-hash diagnostic semantics, and the Test Suite oracle changed. The content-addressed hash cache, shaping, wrapping, generation rollover, unused-entry eviction, and renderer behavior are unchanged.

### Decision

Accept the prehashed-key optimization. Preserve full-field equality and the bounded two-generation cache. Investigate the cardinality and transition pattern of the remaining 320 full `TextLayout` inputs before adding any broader text cache or invalidation generation.
decisionMarkdown: Accept the ordinary line-layout prehashed-key optimization. It removes 601 repeated full-field hashes per warmed frame without a new dependency or cache layer, preserves forced-collision safety and exact two-generation behavior, and improves acknowledged throughput in the measured checkpoint comparison. Retain the one-`u64`-per-owned-key storage cost and do not weaken full equality.
